title: Scalding Spray
body:
Syntax: perform scalding spray <target>

Description: A Boil Release attack that strikes one target. Burning deals extra damage over time.  Requires Boil Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 40-48. 25% chance to inflict burning. Unlocks at level 25. Costs 24 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
